LAW AND MOTION 301, ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE RE: ENFORCEMENT OF ADMINISTRATIVE SUBPOENA. BASED ON THE STIPULATION OF PARTIES, THE COURT ORDERS THAT RESPONDENTS WILL COMPLY WITH THE ADMINISTRATIVE SUBPOENA PRODUCING THE DOCUMENTS REQUESTED IN SAID SUBPOENA TO MR. CONGER ON BEHALF OF PETITIONER NO LATER THAN 60 DAYS FROM TODAY'S DATE. MATTER IS CONTINUED FOR A COMPLIANCE HEARING IN DEPT. 301 ON SEPTEMBER 16, 2026 AT 9:00 A.M. AND OR FOR FURTHER PROCEEDING ON ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE IF NECCESSARY AND APPROPRIATE. (SEE MINI MINUTES FOR COMPLETE RULING) ORDER IS SIGNED. VISITING JUDGE: CINDEE MAYFIELD; CLERK: W. TRUPEK;
